title: Durable onboarding and task-assignment emails
summary: Reuse final onboarding/task transactions and notification policy with an additive private outbox, worker-only Resend fetch delivery, signed durable webhook receipts and default-on task email preference. Both queue creation and delivery default disabled; rollout and real-recipient verification remain separately authorized.
concurrencyRisk: Onboarding transaction/event uniqueness dedupes parallel/replayed completion. Normal and collaborator-removal bulk assignments share transactional activity/mail persistence; errors escape the transaction before mapping to action results. Persisted IDs distinguish A-B-A and suppress obsolete queued events. Deleted tasks are checked before each send/retry; completed/deleted tasks are excluded from bulk reassignment. Admin recipient lookups reuse abortable eight-second Auth fetches. Atomic SKIP LOCKED claims, owned leases, frozen request bytes and stable provider keys handle restarts/timeouts. Advisory transaction locks reconcile early/duplicate/out-of-order receipts. Ambiguous retries stop at eight attempts or 23 hours for operator review.

metrics: email-outbox-delivery heartbeat and overdue queue age

rollback.strategy: Disable RESEND_EMAIL_ENABLED on web and worker; retain additive tables, frozen payloads, provider IDs, receipts and suppression state. Keep Supabase Auth SMTP unchanged. Do not reset ambiguous deliveries or create new keys without provider-history reconciliation. In-flight requests may still complete.
validation: Confirm no new outbox creation/draining while disabled
Recheck onboarding profile/avatar/navigation and task/in-app notification saves
Check webhook ingestion and existing suppression history remain intact

commands: npm run build (build-only credentials; sending disabled)
